summary: Iteration 42 - Testing bug fix (accordion dates '?' → readable dates) and home screen redesign. All features verified: date display fixed, 3-section home screen working, search regression passes.
action_items: MINOR: useEffect at [id].tsx line 99 still uses `slot.slot_type === 'single' && slot.slot_date` (does NOT handle 'specific' type), while the accordion render at line 432 correctly uses `slot.slot_type === 'single' || slot.slot_type === 'specific'`. This mismatch means the 'collapse all except first' behavior in useEffect does not work for 'specific' slots — all accordion groups open by default instead of only the first. Fix: change line 99 to: `const isDateSlot = slot.slot_type === 'single' || slot.slot_type === 'specific'; const key = isDateSlot && slot.slot_date ? slot.slot_date : String(slot.day_of_week ?? 'x');`
critical_code_review_comments: useEffect initial collapsed state mismatch: line 99 only checks slot_type === 'single' but render logic checks 'single' || 'specific'. The collapsedDates set contains wrong keys (day_of_week numbers) for 'specific' slots, causing ALL accordion groups to display expanded instead of only the first being open.

rca_of_issue: Bug root cause: DB slots have slot_type='specific' but the accordion grouping key computation at line 432 only checked slot_type='single'. Fixed by also checking slot_type='specific' in the condition `slot.slot_type === 'single' || slot.slot_type === 'specific'`. Residual minor issue: useEffect (line 99) computing initial collapsed state still only checks for 'single', causing mismatched keys vs render keys for 'specific' slots → all groups open initially.
